Select metabolism records for enzyme CYP2D6. Join metabolism to compound records on substrate record ID to retrieve substrate compound name. Join metabolism to compound records on drug record ID to retrieve parent compound name. Join compound structures on substrate molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return substrate canonical SMILES, substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, organism, and enzyme name. Sort by all returned columns. Limit to 200 rows.
